text: The future of AI is a topic that many people discuss today. Most AI systems we use now are called "narrow AI" because they can only do one specific task, like translating languages or recognising faces. However, researchers are working on artificial general intelligence (AGI), which would be able to understand and learn any task a human can do. Supporters believe AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving serious problems in medicine and science. On the other hand, critics warn about serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive; some predict it within ten years, while others think it is much further away.
